VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: The interval [0,1] is non‑empty, compact (Heine–Borel), and Hausdorff (metric); therefore the uniqueness theorem L3 applies directly. The restricted metric uniformity is compatible by the metric dictionary, and no edge case (singleton, endpoint, empty interior, zero distance) threatens the conclusion. No counterexample exists—compact Hausdorff spaces are uniquely uniformisable, and the metric uniformity is the (unique) one.
